symptom: `create external entities from` an OData service whose navigation properties carry a `Partner` builds with CE6618 "Navigation 'Tags' from external entity 'Buffer' to 'Tag' is not available in the OData service" on every partnered end; check and lint are silent. Reported as "*-to-* navigation properties auto-create ReferenceSet associations"
cause: `createNavigationAssociations` created one association per navigation property, so both ends of a bidirectional (Partner) relationship became separate associations
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_contract.go` (`createNavigationAssociations`, new `partnerNavigation`; `indexExistingAssociations` now indexes the child navigation too)
insight: **The report's framing (multiplicity, *-to-*) was the wrong variable; Partner is the right one.** One contract with four shapes settled it in a single mx check run on 11.12.1: an unpartnered collection (`Peers`, a ReferenceSet) built clean beside partnered ends that all failed — including partnered ONE-to-many, which the report never mentioned. Put the control shape in the same contract, or the multiplicity theory looks confirmed. Then try each candidate form against mxbuild rather than reasoning about Studio Pro: one-to-many as ONE association from the single-valued end with RemoteParent/RemoteChildNavigationProperty + Navigability2=BothDirections -> 0 errors; many-to-many and one-to-one -> CE6618 as one association, as two, and with Owner Both, so Mendix simply does not offer them and the only correct import is to skip and say so. CE6618 is a precise oracle (it names navigation, entities and association), which is what made a five-minute prototype loop possible. A fix that changes what an import creates also needs an upgrade path: modules imported before it still hold the failing associations, and the dedup (existingNav) skips their navs forever, so the re-import names them as runnable `drop association …;` lines; measured: drop + re-import -> 0 errors, and for one-to-many the paired association is then created. That also answers the triage's open question: DROP ASSOCIATION removes a Rest$ODataRemoteAssociationSource association cleanly. Base build 6x CE6618 on the repro, fixed 0. Tests `cmd_contract_partner_nav_test.go`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1231-odata-partnered-navigation-ce6618.mdl`
